changes: Added the per-guild `/wiki` command group so each server can manage its own saved wiki links.
Added `/wiki add` for staff to store a new wiki entry with a validated http(s) link, rejecting duplicate article names in the same server.
Added `/wiki remove` to delete a wiki entry by its exact link, with close-match suggestions when nothing matches.
Added the public `/wiki show` command that posts an embed with a link button for a wiki entry.
Added article-name autocomplete on `/wiki show`, sourced only from the current server's entries.
Wiki entries are stored per guild in the database, so the same article name can exist in different servers.
